cards.meaning: a sudden jump or surge (of prices, numbers)
cards.example: Dahil sa pagsipa ng presyo ng pamasahe, tumaas ang implasyon noong Oktubre.
cards.exampleMeaning: Because of the surge in fares, inflation rose in October.
cards.note: Mula sa 'sipa' (sipain). Mas biglaan at matalim ang dating kaysa 'pagtaas'; madalas sa balitang pang-ekonomiya.
cards.tiesTo: October CPI at 7.8% on 20.1% transport inflation

cards.meaning: to intensify; to become more severe
cards.example: Tumindi ang hirap ng mga tsuper nang sumirit ang presyo ng gasolina.
cards.exampleMeaning: Drivers' hardship intensified when gasoline prices spiked.
cards.note: Pandiwa mula sa 'tindi'. Para sa sitwasyon o damdamin na lumalala; mas matimbang kaysa 'lumala' kapag tungkol sa bigat ng pasanin.
cards.tiesTo: Fare and fuel pressure on commuters

cards.meaning: even if; even though (pairs with 也/还)
cards.example: 即便融资成本下降,企业也不一定愿意扩大投资。
cards.examplePinyin: Jíbiàn róngzī chéngběn xiàjiàng, qǐyè yě bù yídìng yuànyì kuòdà tóuzī.
cards.exampleMeaning: Even if financing costs fall, companies aren't necessarily willing to expand investment.
cards.note: 连词,偏书面语,常搭配'也''还';比口语的'就算'更正式,引出让步假设。Formal concessive; informal equivalent is 就算.
cards.tiesTo: PBOC cutting the buyback re-lending rate to 1.00%

cards.example: 价格下降抑制了企业的利润。
cards.examplePinyin: Jiàgé xiàjiàng yìzhì le qǐyè de lìrùn.
cards.note: 书面语,常搭配'通胀、需求、增长、情绪'。近义词'控制'更中性;'抑制'带有压低的意味。Formal; collocates with demand, inflation, growth.
cards.tiesTo: China services PMI: price cuts squeezing margins
